detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The lake is full. Nobody knows what’s at the bottom.

It’s time to find out.

Empty the Lake

Start with a simple bucket and begin removing water from the lake.

Carry the water to your truck, get paid, and use your earnings to upgrade your tools. The more you upgrade, the faster you can remove water and the deeper you can go.

Every drop brings you closer to the bottom.

Watch the Lake Disappear

The lake starts full of water, hiding everything beneath the surface.

As the water level drops, more of the world is revealed. Objects, structures, and secrets that were hidden underwater slowly begin to emerge.

You never know exactly what you’ll find next.

Work Smarter

Start by doing everything yourself.

Upgrade your bucket to carry more water, increase how much you can extract at once, move faster between the lake and your truck, and unlock tools that make draining the lake easier.

The better your equipment, the faster the lake disappears.

Features

  • 💧 Drain a massive lake one bucket at a time.

  • 💰 Extract water and earn money to buy better equipment.

  • 🪣 Upgrade your buckets to carry more water.

  • ⚡ Increase your extraction power and drain the lake faster.

  • 🏃 Move faster and spend less time carrying water back to your truck.

  • 🌊 Watch the lake level drop and reveal what was hidden beneath it.

  • 🏆 Keep going until you finally reach the bottom.
